common_tsv.escaping: For TSV records only, there is no quoting layer and generated fields contain no literal TAB or LF. Rust Debug payloads in frame text are not TSV fields and use Rust Debug string escapes.
common_tsv.empty_lines: writers do not emit them; readers that ignore them state so in their own profile

reference_reader_profile.blank_lines: ignored by the synthetic read_tsv helper; none of the specified writers emits blank records
reference_reader_profile.strictness: helper-specific validation can be stricter than a production portability validator; see each reader_scope

configuration_value.stability: build-scoped diagnostic value; not an independent configuration wire grammar

row_semantics.msaw_input_manifest_sha256: present only when supplied MSAW manifest input is used; lowercase SHA-256 of the input manifest bytes
row_semantics.performance_sha256: present only when explicit performance input is used; lowercase SHA-256 of the input bytes
row_semantics.profile_omission: historic settings without a profile row are interpreted by the portability reader as DEFAULT_V1
row_semantics.duplicates: the portability profile reader rejects duplicate keys

grammar_ebnf: manifest = header, LF, required-digest-rows, optional-digest-rows, frame-row, {frame-row};
frame-row = "frame", TAB, sequence:u64-decimal, TAB, receipt_ns:nonnegative-i64-decimal, TAB, evidence-filename, TAB, evidence-sha256, TAB, ppm-sha256, LF;
manifest.ppm_filename: frame-{sequence:04}.ppm (derived from sequence; not a separate manifest column)
manifest.producer_order: four required digest rows, optional MSAW/performance digest rows, then frame rows in receipt order
manifest.reader_scope: the portability reader validates required digests and frame-row widths/digests; it currently ignores unrecognized non-frame rows and does not enforce sequence uniqueness/order or receipt monotonicity. Its frame-file reader applies a 64 KiB text cap, below the 512 KiB writer cap. It accepts only nonnegative decimal receipt_ns; admitted session input currently produces nonnegative receipt cutoffs.

complete.authenticates: content integrity only, not producer identity

frame_text.normal_record: normal_prefix followed by Rust pretty Debug value RegionalFrame and LF
frame_text.operated_record: operated_prefix_rows, each LF-terminated, followed by the same Rust pretty Debug value RegionalFrame and LF
debug_value_grammar: value = scalar | rust-string | struct | tuple | sequence | map | enum;
frame_text.stability: diagnostic evidence only. Rust Debug layout and nested fields are scoped to the exact producer executable digest recorded in manifest.tsv and the pinned Rust 1.89.0 toolchain; neither the tag nor this grammar promises a stable general wire API. The regional run manifest omits source_commit; the portability bundle separately records it.
frame_text.reader_scope: The synthetic inspector accepts the producer-sized 512 KiB bound. The separate portability validator accepts at most 64 KiB for imported baseline frame text.

grammar_ebnf: input-stream-row = "input_stream", TAB, stream-id:u64-decimal, TAB, source, TAB, sha256, TAB, compressed-bytes:u64-decimal, TAB, decoded-bytes:u64-decimal, TAB, gzip:("0"|"1"), LF;

metadata_values.centre: four ASCII alphanumeric bytes; typically ZAU1

manifest.stream_rules: one to eight streams; writer preserves stream index order; stream indices are unique decimal strings
manifest.complete: COMPLETE contains lowercase SHA-256(manifest.tsv exact bytes) plus LF

counts.tsv.debug_rows: recording_counts, adapter_counts, quarantine_stats and reasons use Rust Debug formatting scoped to producer executable

recording_import.portability_reader_scope: the reader validates required sidecar lengths/digests, centre, stream row width/source/unique id/hash/decimal fields/gzip flag, and normalized OA-RS header; it does not currently pin all emitted cap rows or reject every unknown row

portability_bundle.serialization: UTF-8 compact JSON with recursively sorted keys and one trailing LF; separators are comma/colon without spaces; JSON standard escaping uses ensure_ascii=true default
portability_bundle.inventory_order: sorted by relative path when serialized
portability_bundle.complete: COMPLETE contains lowercase SHA-256(PORTABILITY.json exact bytes) plus LF
portability_bundle.reader_rules: validates COMPLETE, supported schema, file inventory, safe relative paths, byte lengths and file digests; reader currently permits extra top-level JSON keys
portability_bundle.security: hashes establish integrity and equality, not signature, issuer identity, or authenticity

ordered_rows: clock=recorded receipt cutoffs; local input wall and monotonic time journaled
normalization=positive-address positions and explicit normalized state

configuration_value.stability: build-scoped diagnostic value; exact producer executable digest is recorded in manifest.tsv

grammar_ebnf: manifest = header, LF, mode-row, input-digest-row, model-digest-row, executable-digest-row, settings-file-row, operator-journal-file-row, script-digest-row, {frame-row};
frame-row = "frame", TAB, sequence:u64-decimal, TAB, receipt_ns:decimal, TAB, evidence-filename, TAB, evidence-sha256, TAB, ppm-filename, TAB, ppm-sha256, LF;
manifest.complete: COMPLETE contains lowercase SHA-256(manifest.tsv exact bytes) plus LF
manifest.reader_scope: producer binds settings, operator journal, and input/model/executable/script digests. No separate production portability validator for this operated-session manifest was identified. The synthetic reference reader imposes a 64 MiB local parse bound; this is not a producer format limit.

operator_journal.encoding: UTF-8 LF-terminated records without a header; tab-delimited, no quoting layer
record_grammar: record = RESEQUENCE | LOCAL | ACTION | ACTOR | QUIT | OVERLAY | SELECT | QUEUE | REFUSAL | CONSOLE | CLEAR_SELECTION | INPUT_LOSS | ACTION_REJECTED | INPUT_RESYNC_INITIAL | VT_RELEASE | VT_CLEAR_SELECTION | VT_REACQUIRE | INPUT_RESYNC | INPUT_IGNORED | INPUT_DISCARDED;
RESEQUENCE = tag, ordinal, source, original-sequence, assigned-sequence, receipt_ns;
LOCAL = tag, ordinal, "FLIGHT", "0", assigned-sequence, receipt_ns;
ACTION = tag, ordinal, wall_ms, monotonic_ns, cutoff_ns, Action-Debug;
ACTOR = tag, ordinal, unit_id, wall_ms, monotonic_ns;
QUIT = tag, ordinal, wall_ms, monotonic_ns;
OVERLAY = tag, "FRAME", sequence, lowercase-sha256;
SELECT = tag, ordinal, address_hex8, generation, view_sequence, gufi_sha256, centre_sha256, plan_id_sha256, overlay_sha256;
QUEUE = tag, ordinal, address_decimal, generation, view_sequence, gufi_sha256, centre_sha256, plan_id_sha256, actor_id, Intent-Debug, wall_ms, monotonic_ns;
REFUSAL = tag, ordinal, reason-with-TAB-and-LF-replaced-by-space;
CONSOLE = tag, ordinal, wall_ms, monotonic_ns, safe-overlay-text, lowercase-sha256;
CLEAR_SELECTION = tag, reason, lowercase-sha256;
INPUT_LOSS = tag, ordinal, kind, discarded-command-count, cutoff_ns, wall_ms, monotonic_ns;
ACTION_REJECTED = tag, ordinal, wall_ms, monotonic_ns, cutoff_ns, reason;
INPUT_RESYNC_INITIAL = tag, discarded-record-count, relative-motion-lost, input-snapshot-sha256, monotonic_ns;
VT_RELEASE = tag, discarded-command-count, pending-line-bytes, cutoff_ns, inactive-discard-count, wall_ms, monotonic_ns;
VT_CLEAR_SELECTION = tag, lowercase-sha256;
VT_REACQUIRE = tag, inactive-discard-count, discarded-record-count, relative-motion-lost, input-snapshot-sha256, cutoff_ns, wall_ms, monotonic_ns;

INPUT_RESYNC = tag, discarded-record-count, relative-motion-lost, input-snapshot-sha256, cutoff_ns, wall_ms, monotonic_ns; or tag, discarded-record-count, relative-motion-lost, cutoff_ns, wall_ms, monotonic_ns;
INPUT_IGNORED = tag, next-action-ordinal, event-kind, event-code;
INPUT_DISCARDED = tag, next-action-ordinal, discarded-record-count;
operator_journal.value_scope: Action-Debug and Intent-Debug are Rust Debug diagnostics scoped to the exact producer build; wall_ms is Unix wall-clock milliseconds and monotonic_ns is process-relative monotonic nanoseconds where emitted.

operated_replay.debug_frame_reference: The operated frame text prefix and RegionalFrame pretty-Debug payload grammar are shared with regional_run.frame_text; the two prefixed digest rows occur only in operated frames.
